=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:487-500 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The pagination guard can report a status-filtered listing complete when one run leaves and another enters between page reads but `total_count` stays unchanged, causing the newly entered run to be missed.
  WHY: `_mt_release` can then miss an active review for the queued PR and dispatch a duplicate; severity ranged from MAJOR to BLOCKER, with qwen_qwen3_7-plus assigning BLOCKER and the other reviewers assigning MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The conformance fix should make a status-filtered paged listing safe against every shape of shift a run can cause between page reads, not only the shape where `total_count` changes.
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh lines 487-497; tests/test_review_merge_train.py
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The guard compares only `__mt_runs_total` against `__mt_runs_first_total`; the new tests cover shrink (150 → 140) and grow (150 → 155), but no test covers a same-count membership shift with a 200-run listing; `actions_runs_after_page1.json` supports later-page responses; the conformance entry in `docs/implement-plan/issue-5443-merge-train-complete-run-listing.md` documents only the total-count-change fix.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:492-497 (the __mt_runs_first_total capture and listing_shifted check) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The pagination guard treats a listing as stable when total_count stays equal between page 1 and later pages, even though membership can change when one run leaves the status and another enters between page reads.
  WHY: Distinct IDs from both pages can reach total_count without including the new run, so _mt_release dispatches a duplicate review beside it.

=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:lines 492-500 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The pagination shift guard only compares total_count against page 1 (__mt_runs_total -ne __mt_runs_first_total), which does not detect concurrent membership shifts when active runs leave and enter the status filter in equal numbers between page requests.
  WHY: _mt_inflight_review_branches can terminate with success without recording the newly active run, leading _mt_release to evaluate the queued PR as having no in-flight review and dispatching a duplicate review run.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:487-497 (the new `__mt_runs_first_total` capture and `listing_shifted` check) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fix only detects a shifted listing when `__mt_runs_total` changes between page 1 and a later page; a same-count membership shift keeps `total_count` unchanged while the listing's membership moves.
  WHY: The distinct IDs read reach `total_count`, the listing is reported complete, and an active review run for the queued PR can be missed.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The conformance fix should make a status-filtered paged listing safe against every shape of shift a run can cause between page reads, not only the shape where `total_count` changes. The original defect (conformance 1/3) was that the listing could appear complete while a still-active run had been skipped; the fix narrows the trigger to `total_count` changes and leaves the same-count membership shift case (one run leaves the status filter and another enters the same status between two page reads, with `total_count` unchanged) unhandled.
  Expected change site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh lines 487-497 (the new `__mt_runs_first_total` / `listing_shifted` guard), plus a paired regression test in tests/test_review_merge_train.py next to the two new `test_release_leaves_pr_queued_when_listing_shrinks_between_pages` / `…_grows_…` tests.
  Evidence of absence: The new guard compares only `__mt_runs_total` against `__mt_runs_first_total`; the same-count shift keeps them equal and the loop breaks via the existing `read >= total` path. The two new tests exercise shrink (150 → 140) and grow (150 → 155); no test runs a 200-run listing with one run finishing and another entering between page 1 and page 2. The fake `gh` infrastructure already supports this case (the new `actions_runs_after_page1.json` path serves every later page), and the conformance entry in `docs/implement-plan/issue-5443-merge-train-complete-run-listing.md` documents only the total-count-change fix without naming the same-count gap. AD-7 in the same log poses the question as "How should the active-run listing treat a `total_count` that changes between pages of one status?" — the same-count membership shift was not asked.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:492-499 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The pagination guard treats the listing as stable when page 1 and a later page have the same `total_count`, even if the listing’s membership shifted.
  WHY: `_mt_release` can miss an active review for the queued PR, remove its queue label, and dispatch another review (lines 587-625).
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:487-500 (the `__mt_runs_first_total` capture and `listing_shifted` check) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The guard detects a shifted listing only when `total_count` changes between pages; a same-count membership shift leaves `total_count` unchanged while the listing's membership moves.
  WHY: The distinct IDs read still reach `total_count`, so the listing is reported complete and the active review run for a queued PR can be missed, triggering a duplicate review run.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:487-500 (the `__mt_runs_first_total` capture at 492-493 and the `__mt_runs_total != __mt_runs_first_total` check at 494, followed by the `__mt_runs_read >= __mt_runs_total` break at 498) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new shift guard detects only a `total_count` change between page 1 and later pages; a same-count membership shift evades the guard.
  WHY: The listing is reported complete, so `_mt_release` can miss the active review and dispatch a duplicate beside it.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_2 ===
